D1.features: P5 exact12 absolute+same12 relative by substrate; common24 for all PL-only models; IDPL56; ID32

D2.features: P4 exact4channels mean/last/relative-index-slope, 12 absolute or12relative; common REL12 main; IDPL44

outer_folds: Original P6 D1 author5fold / D2 seven date folds, unchanged
inner_folds: GroupKFold(3) on OUTER TRAIN labels, grouped substrate/date; all current-unit optical context legal, scaler/floor fitted inner train only
features: D1 originalP5 12 LP725 statistics; D2 originalP4 four-channel12 statistics; REL=robust median/MADz plus centered optical percentile ranks (24), ABS12, optional POS32 categories
gates: apply AFTER training-only StandardScaler; relative gate1 or.25, position gate always.25; not selected from validation/test groups
W1_selection: per outer context independently pick highest equal-independent-group inner-CV Top25 gain, then rho, overlap, then lower feature count and viewID; ABS included
W2_selection: joint maximin normalized relative gain: own outer-TRAIN inner-CV plus OTHER dataset ALL-development inner-CV (separately trained); baseline always inner-CV ABS; maximize min(relativeD1,relativeD2), then mean, then fewer active modules, moduleID. Denominator max(abs(baselineGain),.1). Other dataset metrics contain no own-dataset outer validation labels, and views are selected independently before joint module ranking
joint_development_disclosure: Both datasets development labels inform method selection; NOT untuned external validation; weights never pooled or transferred. D1/D2 differentouterfold counts; other-dataset full training-context evidence only
ablation_rule: predeclared diagnostics, not eligible final candidates; use selected view/module in each OUTER TRAIN context and remove one module; ordinary/TopK comparisons same view; negative control fixed DUAL-only BASE and shuffle half training independentgroups within each unit
forced_on_ablations: TOPK_ONLY uses selected boost if>1 else2; ROBUST_ONLY uses selected eta/q if active else.25/.25; AUG_ONLY fixed .95/1.05; LIST_ONLY lambda.1; no-module variants identical to selected method if corresponding selected module was already off, explicitly report ties
pair_tolerance: unchanged D1 abs(deltaPCE)>0.5 / D2>=0.5; all evaluation rows retained; pair identity fixed across optical views and TopK weights
topk_weights: boost1/2/4 only cross-training-true-Topceil(n/4) boundary pairs; renormalize within each experiment to preserve original date/substrate contribution; symmetric pairs, no pair sampling
custom_objective: group mean of (1-lambda)*pair logistic +lambda*soft-target list CE, plus smooth CVaR blend and same C1 regularizer1/(2*NoriginalPairs); derivative tested. CVaR softplus temp.05; independent group=sub/date, experiments equal within date. Effective risk coefficient bound <=1-eta+eta/q<=1.75
soft_list_target: training sigmoid((PCE-midpoint trueTopk boundary)/.5pp), normalize unit sum1; output softmax score temperature1; labels only train; no validation/test target construction
amplitude_augmentation: training original +global gain.95 +gain1.05 views, all real channels/time multiplied together; D1 dimensionless argmax/relativechange unchanged; fit scaler original only, transform each copy separately; preserve total original pair weight and regularization, no added evaluation rows
negative_control: half independent TRAIN groups selected by seededSHA256; within each unit shuffle optical statistics among region IDs, preserve targets and all candidate rows; negative control only, never final selection
aggregation: D1 substrate equal, D2 experiment equal then date equal
M4: NOT_RUN_OPTIONAL: no default neural expansion; bounded hand-feature W1/W2 and full frozen nested W3 prioritized, no new architecture search
checkpoint_policy: each completed stage writes CSV/config checkpoint; second full run deterministic replay with same all-inner-search and outer predictions; only runtime/resource receipts excluded comparison
history_policy: no new-candidate historical prediction until W3 selections/protocol freeze; then once descriptive evaluation, secondrun exact replay; do not select/history-tune
